# Karan Wakhare

> AI engineer and full stack developer in Pune. He builds AI products and web apps. He built a WhatsApp grocery assistant and a tool for saving and comparing AI prompts.

## Builds

- [Grocer](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/grocer): A WhatsApp grocery assistant. Send it a list, and it checks live Instamart stock, suggests swaps, and waits for your tap before ordering.
- [Outpost](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/outpost): A planning tool for stores that deliver groceries in minutes. It spots likely stockouts and suggests stock moves or reorders. A person approves each one.
- [Git for Prompts](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/git-for-prompts): Save every version of an AI prompt, compare changes, and test old versions offline.
- [Beam](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/beam): A small pill above your Windows 11 taskbar for music, files, timers, and your calendar. It works offline.

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://karan30.vercel.app): About, builds, stack, GitHub activity, and photos.
- [Artifacts](https://karan30.vercel.app/artifacts): Photos from trips to Dubai, Singapore, Abu Dhabi, Udaipur, and Pune.
